translations.web: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
translations.bsb: As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; even the autumn rain covers it with pools.
translations.kjv: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
translations.asv: Passing through the valley of Weeping they make it a place of springs; Yea, the early rain covereth it with blessings.
